# oriz Name — full

oriz Name is a free, 100% client-side name generator at https://name.oriz.in for the oriz.in family.

## What it does
Generates candidate names for brands, products, startups, usernames, and code repositories. You pick a category and a "vibe" (playful, technical, minimal, elegant, bold), and it produces on-brief name ideas plus optional taglines.

## How it works
- Runs entirely in your browser — no upload, no signup, no server.
- AI suggestions use g4f/gpt4free (keyless, multi-provider failover). If AI providers are unavailable, the core generator still works.
- .com-style availability is a client-side heuristic; use the provided links to verify on a registrar.

## Privacy
Nothing leaves your device. No tracking, no ads. MIT licensed.
